entries.8af37ffe304033d6: This business develops software centered on groupware, operates cloud services, sells licenses and provides customization, and offers maintenance services and consulting. Its main product is the groupware 'desknet's NEO', and it also offers the no-code business application creation tool 'AppSuite' and the business chat 'ChatLuck'. The company and its U.S. subsidiary DELCUI Inc. operate this business, providing the DaaS cloud service for enterprises and also selling the products and services of U.S. companies in Japan. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥6,217 million.
